\newcommand{\FrontierWarmCaption}{Warm, single harness, exploratory, Zen~2 (AMD Threadripper PRO 3995WX, shared host). Live streams per core sustained at p99 lateness of at most \LatenessBoundMs\,ms (top axis: per CCX, \DenWorkers{} single-threaded workers; \LadderScope) against WER on the 400 dev-clean utterances of the DEV panel, measured in the same harness for the same checkpoints. Dense: the latest checkpoint (average of steps 55/60/65k), greedy (circle) and beam~4 (diamond) at the same density. R0 and multirate come from the clean same-session run; in the dense run the loaded host cut R0 to \RzeroLoadedCCX{} streams per CCX, so that R0 is not used. Whiskers run to the first failed rung. Hollow: the earlier step-45k checkpoint, \DenDenseFortyFiveRangeLo--\DenDenseFortyFiveRangeHi{} streams per CCX over two runs.}

\newcommand{\RehearsalCaption}{Warm single-harness rehearsal (exploratory): R0 Zipformer INT8, the earlier dense average (steps 45/50/55k; the latest dense checkpoint of that harness is in \cref{fig:frontier}) and the multirate model at step 50k, all prepared INT8, in one \texttt{ultra bench-suite} executable on a shared AMD Threadripper PRO 3995WX (Zen~2). Density: \DenWorkers{} single-threaded workers on one CCX, \DenRungSeconds{}~s ladder rungs, one repeat; R0 and multirate densities were identical in \DenReproRuns{} runs; the earlier dense step-45k checkpoint reached \DenDenseFortyFiveRangeLo--\DenDenseFortyFiveRangeHi{} per CCX over two runs. Left: whole-service CPU-seconds per audio-second at the matched \MatchedRung-stream rung against WER on the panel's 400 dev-clean utterances, measured in the same harness and executable. Right: highest sustained streams per CCX, with each checkpoint's WER.}
\newcommand{\MoneyCaption}{Each point is one recogniser decoding the same 730 LibriSpeech DEV utterances (\ColdAudioMinutes{} minutes) as a cold process on one pinned core of an AMD Threadripper PRO 3995WX (Zen~2), model load included; median of three runs. Speed is audio-seconds per CPU-second; WER is on the 400 dev-clean utterances of that panel. \ColdOrderSentence{} Filled marks: live streaming systems. Hollow marks: whole-utterance systems, which see the whole clip before they emit a word. Diamonds: ours. Dashed: the streaming systems that no other streaming system beats on both axes. \MoneyWattsCaption{} \ColdHostSentence{} Exploratory.}
